# AI4SE plugins runtime

Version: [VERSION](VERSION).

This is the runtime subset bundled with the baseline. See the
[command catalog](commands/catalog.md), [stage recipes](recipes/),
[integration notes](integrations/), and [agent descriptions](agents/README.md).
The parent [dependency notice](../README.md) explains versions and maintenance.

Shared helper scripts retain the original package layout. The baseline's
`scripts/refresh-agent-assets.mjs` regenerates portable Qoder and Copilot copies.
